title: Empty World with Structures
description: Empty world with biomes and structures ! [CHALLENGE]
body:
### Empty World - Structures

---

## Dimensions

**Void Dimensions** — void noise for **Overworld, Nether, End** (no normal ground). 
Vanilla dimension IDs vanilla structure sets apply where worldgen allows.

---

## Structures That Generate

**✅ generating structures** Villages, pillager outposts, desert pyramids, jungle temples, swamp huts, igloos, ocean monuments, buried treasure, fossils, trail ruins, and similar small overworld structures. Nether bastion remnants, Nether Fortress. 

**✅ (non structures)** End obsidian pillars + spawn platform

**❌ Not generating structures** Woodland mansions & End cities
